observations.classification: observed behaviour asymmetry, NOT an ABI violation and NOT a G2 gate
observations.what: On flac-16-44-stereo, after the handle has been drained to EOF, song_seek() to a target inside the LAST FLAC frame (target >= 3762000 us on this fixture; the last frame starts at 3761633 us) returns 110 SONG_ERR_SEEK_ERROR, song_last_error message 'container seek failed', native_code -1. Targets <= 3761000 us succeed. Without the prior EOF, the same targets succeed and land at 3761633 us.
observations.repro: op-probe-static <flac> d s:3761000 e    -> status 0, landing 376143? (see log) ; op-probe-static <flac> d s:3762000 e -> status 110
observations.handle_state_after: handle remains usable: a later seek to 2000000 us returns status 0, and reads still terminate in SONG_EOF with 0 frames
observations.other_fixtures: mp3 / alac (4 s) / alac (6 s) do not show it (near-end seek after EOF succeeds)
observations.why_not_gated: songcore.h types this as a legal error class (SONG_ERR_SEEK_ERROR) and the G2 7.1 scenario only requires seeks at 25/50/75% of duration; those pass on all four fixtures. Whether a post-EOF seek must succeed is a product-semantics question outside this lane.
